tiers.everyday: Teotihuacan near Mexico City was a huge planned city with the Sun and Moon pyramids. It rose during the 1st through 7th centuries AD.
tiers.student: UNESCO says Teotihuacan, about 50 km from Mexico City to the north-east, rose during the 1st through 7th centuries AD and is known for the Sun and Moon pyramids and the Temple of Quetzalcoatl. Inscribed 1987.

timeline.event: The city rose during the 1st through 7th centuries AD
